accessNotes: The three public plan pages exposed list prices and current summer-sale prices. Only the struck-through EUR list prices are captured; SUMMER30, SUMMER25 and SUMMER15 sale prices are intentionally excluded because they are temporary. India is absent from the 6-country restriction list published by BrightFunded on 2026-04-20 and recaptured on 2026-07-27, but that is an availability observation rather than a legal or regulatory approval.

fieldEvidence.profitTargets: The 1-Step page says 'Profit Target 10% Phase 1'; the current-rules article also lists 1-Step Phase 1 at 10%.
fieldEvidence.drawdownType: The 1-Step rule article states the 6% maximum drawdown follows the real-time high-water mark and locks at the original balance after 6% growth.
fieldEvidence.profitSplitPct: Reward Split article: 'The Profit Split is 80/20 by default' and 90% requires an add-on.
fieldEvidence.payoutFirstDays: Reward Split article: first reward split after 30 days from the first funded trade; later requests are every 14 days.
fieldEvidence.rules.news: Challenge phases are unrestricted, but funded accounts prohibit executions in the 5 minutes before and after listed high-impact news; therefore restricted.
fieldEvidence.rules.weekend: BrightFunded says positions may be held over the weekend.
fieldEvidence.rules.overnight: BrightFunded says positions do not need to be closed overnight.
fieldEvidence.rules.ea: EAs are allowed, but API and automated trading are not supported on DXtrade; therefore restricted.
fieldEvidence.rules.copyTrading: Copying is allowed only between accounts owned by the same person; therefore restricted.
fieldEvidence.refundable: Refund Policy: a purchase within 30 days can be refunded only if no trades have been made.

notes: All fees are EUR list prices. Temporary SUMMER30 pricing is deliberately excluded.
The 6% maximum drawdown trails the highest equity in real time and locks at the original balance after the account reaches 6% growth.
The base funded reward split is 80%; 90% is a paid add-on and 100% is available only through scaling.
The first standard payout window is 30 days after the first funded trade, then 14 days. Weekly or earlier cycles are paid add-ons.
News trading is unrestricted in evaluation but has a 10-minute execution restriction on funded accounts.
The separately advertised 100% challenge-fee refund is a checkout add-on, not included in the captured list price.
